description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different transformer layer groups for four KV cache compression configurations, as evaluated in the paper “More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision Trade-off in KV Cache Compression.” The x-axis represents grouped transformer layers — Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32 — with no numerical scale, treated as categorical intervals. The y-axis, labeled “Relative Change,” is linear and ranges from -25% to +5%, with major tick marks at 5% intervals. Four distinct lines are plotted: the yellow line with circle markers (LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit) remains near 0% across all layers, dipping slightly to approximately -2% in Layer5-12 and Layer13-20 before returning to near 0%. The red line with square markers (LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit) starts near 0%, drops to -4% in Layer5-12, reaches -6% in Layer13-20, then recovers to -1% in Layer29-32. The light blue line with circle markers (RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit) begins at -2%, declines to -4% in Layer5-12, plunges to -13% in Layer13-20, then rises to -2% in Layer29-32. The dark blue line with square markers (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) starts at -3%, drops to -5% in Layer5-12, falls sharply to -25% in Layer13-20, then recovers to -4% in Layer29-32. A gray horizontal bar at the top of the plot, spanning Layer5-12 to Layer21-28, highlights a region of interest, while a dashed gray line at 0% serves as a baseline reference.
